resources.string: Exposure: overall brightness. Move right to brighten.
Highlights: only the brightest parts. Pull left to bring back sky detail.
Shadows: only the darkest parts. Move right to lift them.
Whites and Blacks: set the brightest and darkest points.
Texture: fine detail such as skin and bark.
Clarity: contrast in the middle tones. Adds punch.
Dehaze: cuts through haze and mist, or adds it.
Vibrance: boosts dull colours and protects strong ones.
Grain: film-like noise for a classic look.
